lines: All right. I will wait here.

I will keep watch from here.

I will not wander away from this spot.

I can rest here and watch the road.
I will stay near the supplies.
If trouble comes, I will defend this ground.
The next order can find me right here.
I am stopping here, just as you asked.
You lead on. I will remain behind.
This will be my post for now.
I have a clear view from this place.
I will wait, but I will stay alert.
Nothing else needs me more than this order.

We part ways here, then.

I will head back toward the village.

Your path is mine for now.
I will come along.
Let us go before it gets late.

I will follow your steps from here.
Keep moving. I will be close behind.
I am leaving this spot with you.
Take us where we need to go.
All right. We travel together now.
All right. I will stay here.
I will hold this spot until you return.
Go on. I can wait here.
This place is fine. I will stay put.
I will keep watch from here.
You know where to find me.
I will not wander far from this spot.
I can manage here on my own.
I will wait here unless danger forces me away.
This is my post for now.
I will stay close to this place.
Come back when you are ready for me.

I will keep my feet right here.
Leave me here for now.
I will return to this spot if I have to move.
This ground will do. I am staying.
I will wait and keep out of trouble.
I am not going anywhere.
Go do what you need to do. I will be here.
All right. I will stop staying here.
I can move around again.
I will leave this spot behind.
I am done holding this place.
I do not need to wait here anymore.

This is not my post now.
I will stop returning to this spot.
Fine. I am free to wander again.
I will get moving.
You no longer need me to stay put.
I am leaving this place now.
The wait is over, then.
I will choose my own path again.
I understand. I can leave this spot.
I have held this place long enough.
I will not treat this as my post anymore.
All right. I am moving on.
I can stretch my legs again.
Then there is no reason to remain here.
I am already following someone else.
Only the person I follow can give me that order.
That decision belongs to the one leading me.
I will not take commands from two people at once.

Those orders are not yours to give me.

There you are. It has been {days_since_seen_phrase}.
I was wondering when you would come back.

The village has not seen you since {days_since_seen_phrase}.
Back at last. I hope the journey treated you well.
I remember your face, even after {days_since_seen} {day_or_days}.
A few people asked whether you were coming back.
You picked a fine day to return.
The paths finally brought you home again.
I nearly stopped expecting to see you at my door.
It feels longer than {days_since_seen_phrase} since we spoke.
Welcome back. What kept you away?
Life carried on here, but we noticed your absence.
You look like the road gave you a story or two.
I hope you found what you went looking for.
Things have changed since your last visit.
I kept thinking I saw you in the distance.
You were missed more than you might think.
Come in from the road. You have been gone long enough.

You missed a lot while you were gone.
Was the road scary, or just muddy?
I knew you would come back eventually.
Did anything chase you on the way home?
You have been gone for so many sleeps.
I saved a hundred questions for when you returned.
Were there mountains where you went?
Everyone said you were traveling. I wanted to come too.
I almost forgot how your voice sounded.
Tell me the best thing you saw first.
You came back on the exact day I stopped counting.
Did you find treasure, or only sore feet?
The village felt quieter without you around.
I hope you remembered where we live.
Hey, you are <jump>back</jump> after {days_since_seen_phrase}!
You asked me to trust you, then you hurt me.
I should never have followed you.
That is not how a leader protects someone.
Stay away. I know what your promises are worth now.
You turned my trust into a weapon.
I followed because I thought I would be safe.
The road was dangerous enough without fearing you too.
You do not get to lead me after that.
I will remember who struck first.
Following you was a mistake I will not repeat.
You made me regret leaving the village.
I trusted your direction, not your cruelty.
A leader watches your back. You attacked mine.
Do not ask for loyalty after breaking it.
You left me wondering whether I would survive the trip.
I would rather walk alone than follow you again.
The next person you recruit deserves a warning.
Whatever agreement we had ended when you hurt me.
You made every step beside you feel foolish.

No. Stay away from me.
I have nothing to say to you.
The village knows what you have done.
Do not come any closer.
You have exhausted every bit of my patience.
I will not pretend we are on speaking terms.
Find someone else to bother.
Your reputation reached me before you did.
I do not owe you another chance.
Leave before this becomes an argument.
There is no conversation worth having between us.
I remember enough to know I want you gone.
You are not welcome at my door.
Nothing you say will make me trust you today.
I would rather work in silence than listen to you.
The answer is no, whatever you planned to ask.
Go trouble another village.
I am choosing peace, and that means avoiding you.
You have done too much harm for polite words.
<shake>Get away from me.</shake>
Not now. I am too angry to talk.
Give me time before you ask anything.
I need space to cool down.
Come back when I can answer without shouting.
My temper is not ready for company.
I will regret my words if we speak now.
Whatever you want can wait.
Leave me alone until this anger passes.
I cannot listen while my blood is still boiling.
A quiet walk would help more than a conversation.
You are the last person I want near me right now.
Let the day settle before we try this again.
I need a moment where nobody asks anything of me.
My hands are still shaking. Please go.
There is no useful answer in me at the moment.
Pushing me now will only make this worse.
I am trying not to say something cruel.
Ask tomorrow. Today has already gone badly.
I can speak fairly once I am calm.
Let the <shake>anger</shake> settle first.
Not now. I have work to finish.
Give me a minute to handle this.
My hands are full at the moment.
I cannot leave this task halfway done.
Come back when the workbench is clear.
The day is already running ahead of me.
I need to finish what I started.
This will go badly if I stop paying attention.
Ask me after I put these tools away.
Someone is waiting on this work.
I heard you, but I cannot answer properly yet.
Let me reach a safe stopping point first.
The job will not finish itself.
I have too many things moving at once.
If it can wait, please let it wait.
I am in the middle of something delicate.
Find me when this load is delivered.
I promised this task would be done today.
Talking now would slow both of us down.

They are unable to speak at the moment.
The villager does not respond.

They cannot focus enough to talk.
The villager is still incapacitated.
They need to recover before you try again.
The villager cannot act right now.
They are not well enough to respond.

I cannot do that right now.
That option is not available anymore.
The circumstances have changed since you last asked.
I am not in a state to help with that.
You will need to try someone else.
Whatever allowed that before is gone now.
I cannot make that choice from here.
The village rules will not permit it.
This is beyond what I can offer today.
Nothing will happen if you keep pressing it.
That request no longer fits my situation.
I would help if the option were still open.
The answer changed when my circumstances did.
Come back if the situation changes again.
I do not have access to that action now.
There is no safe way for me to continue.

I cannot promise it will open again soon.

We can leave it there.
I think this conversation has run its course.
There is nothing more to settle right now.
Let us get back to our day.
You have your answer, and I have my work.
We are finished here.
I would rather not repeat myself.
The matter is closed as far as I am concerned.
We can speak again when there is something new.
I have no more time for this today.
This feels like a good place to stop.
Neither of us will gain anything by continuing.
I said what needed saying.
Go safely. Our talk is over.
The last word can rest where it is.
I am ending this conversation now.
We have gone as far as we can.
No more questions today, please.
That is <gradient:dark_purple:light_purple><pulse>the end</pulse></gradient> of it.
I am not sure what you mean.
Could you ask that another way?
That choice does not make sense to me.
I do not have an answer for that.

Try choosing something else.

There is nothing in my bag that concerns you.
Ask before reaching for what I carry.
Trust comes before shared storage.
I do not know you well enough for this.
My supplies are staying with me.
The inventory screen is unavailable right now.
I would rather count my things alone.
Do not treat my pack like a public chest.
I need more reason to believe you are honest.
This boundary is not up for debate.
Come back when we know each other better.
Nobody looks through my belongings without permission.
I am responsible for every item I carry.

We are not close enough yet.

You are asking for more faith than I have.
Give our acquaintance time to grow.
I need to see what kind of person you are first.

I am not ready to place that in your hands.
We have barely shared a road together.
Ask again after you have helped the village.
I do not hand out trust because someone requests it.
There is still too much I do not know about you.
This answer may change once we have history.
I need deeds, not promises.
You have not done anything terrible. It is simply too soon.

Let us begin with smaller favors.
I am careful because trust is hard to repair.
We are <pulse>not there yet</pulse>.
I cannot accept a gift right now.
Please keep it until another time.
The timing is wrong for presents.
I am not able to receive anything today.
Whatever you are offering will have to wait.

This is not a refusal of your kindness.
Try again once the situation settles.

I would rather refuse than waste it.

I would rather refuse than lose your gift.

Nothing else will fit without leaving something behind.
Give me time to sort through my things.
This pack was not made for endless storage.

I would only slow your group down right now.
